In the game Saints Row, players engage in various activities such as Mayhem, where they maximize property destruction before a time expires. Some of these activities were introduced in previous Saints Row games. These activities serve the plot and are positioned as training the player-character or damaging the Syndicate. They can also be repeated. Outside of structured diversions, the group —Carlos Fonseca— explained to him, the original had been lost, so they decided to look for the one closest to the sequence —taken a second before or after the other— to replace it. "It was almost the same, only in this one I had a lost look."
